title: Accounts Assistant
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Rugby / DIRFT
Full-time 40 hours per week
Permanent

Macildowie are delighted to be partnering with a growing, privately owned property and development business to recruit an Accounts Assistant into their finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied, hands-on finance role and wants to join an energetic, fast-moving and down-to-earth business.

Working closely with the Financial Controllers and wider finance team, you'll take responsibility for a broad range of transactional accounting duties across several group companies. The role offers plenty of variety, covering both purchase and sales ledger activity alongside credit control, cashbooks, reconciliations and general finance support.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Setting up and maintaining customer accounts and producing sales invoices
- Investigating and resolving customer queries
- Reviewing customer accounts and chasing outstanding debts
- Processing purchase invoices and credit card receipts
- Reconciling supplier statements
- Managing multiple purchase ledger inboxes and responding to invoice queries
- Setting up cashbook payments
- Maintaining cashbooks and completing weekly bank reconciliations
- Ensuring invoices receive the correct VAT and CIS treatment
- Producing ad hoc project spend reports
- Filing and maintaining finance documentation
- Supporting the year-end audit process
- Providing wider administrative and finance support as required

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is practical, enthusiastic and comfortable rolling their sleeves up as part of a close-knit team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within an accounts or transactional finance role
- Strong attention to detail
- Good communication and relationship-building skills
- The ability to manage your own workload and work to deadlines
- Confidence balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- A proactive, flexible and resilient approach
- Intermediate Excel skills

Experience using COINS, Sage 50 and/or Xero would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

The business is also forward-thinking in its approach to technology, so an interest in using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve or automate accounting processes would be particularly welcome.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation where you'll be part of a small, dedicated team and have exposure to a genuinely varied range of finance activities.

If you're an Accounts Assistant looking for a broad role within a fast-paced, personable and hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Macildowie for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

Interested? Apply today or contact SF Partners for more information.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Responsibilities include processing client and office account transactions, handling receipts and payments, maintaining accurate financial records, performing daily and monthly bank reconciliations, managing purchase ledger activities, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal accounting procedures.

The position involves regular use of banking platforms and legal accounting software to process CHAPS/BACS payments, allocate receipts, reconcile accounts, post invoices and journals, administer petty cash, and maintain financial documentation for audit purposes. The role also requires liaising with colleagues, suppliers, banks, auditors, and clients to resolve queries and ensure smooth financial operations.

Key Requirements
- Previous experience in an accounts, finance, or bookkeeping environment
- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
- Comfortable working to deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Team-oriented, approachable, and professional
- Experience with reconciliations, purchase ledger, and payment processing would be advantageous

This role would suit an organised and detail-focused finance professional looking to develop their accounting skills within a supportive and structured environment.

title: Activities & Coaching Operations Coordinator
company: Riding for the Disabled Association (RDA) - Agency - Permanent
description:
Activities and Coaching Operations Coordinator

At Riding for the Disabled Association (RDA), we enrich lives through the unique bond between people and horses. Each year, we support over 39,000 disabled children and adults through activities including riding, carriage driving, and equine assisted programmes such as Quiet Corners and Tea with a Pony. We are pioneers in the therapeutic use of horses, leaders in disability sport, and the only major UK charity focused specifically on the health and wellbeing benefits of bringing people and horses together.

We welcome people of all ages and abilities, including those with physical and learning disabilities, sensory impairments, long-term health conditions, and neurodiversity. With 24% of the UK population classified as disabled, we make a lasting impact through the therapeutic power of horses.

We are now looking for an Activities and Coaching Operations Coordinator to join the team at our national office in Warwickshire and help us to continue our work.

Role Purpose

To support the coordination, development, and effective delivery of RDA participants' activities, ensuring objectives are achieved in line with the charity's strategic priorities. The postholder will provide coordination, administrative and compliance support, contributing to the safe, consistent and effective delivery of participant activities and associated coaching processes. RDA activities include riding, carriage driving, vaulting and other specialist or emerging activities that support participant development, achievement and wellbeing.

Specific Responsibilities

Activities Support & Coordination
- Assist with the coordination of specialist activities including carriage driving, vaulting and other developing activity areas.
- Act as a first point of response for activity-related enquiries from RDA Groups, volunteers and coaches.
- Develop, maintain and review activity related guidance, resources, forms and information.
- Support activity advisory groups and associated projects, including meeting administration, actions and follow-up as required.
- Provide operational and administrative support to the wider Coaching and Equine Team to facilitate effective service delivery

Activity Compliance & Coaching Support
- Support the implementation and communication of activity standards, guidance, and recommendations.
- Support the collection and maintenance of information relating to activity-specific concerns, actions and follow-up requirements.
- Support with quality assurance and information gathering processes relating to activities and coaching.
- Provide support and assistance with coaching administration, including training and assessment, coaching pathway and the maintenance of forms, guidance and resources.

Team Administration & Operational Support
- Planning and facilitation of internal and external meetings, including agenda distribution, minute taking and follow-up actions as required.
- Processing and recording of paperwork relating to activities and coaching.
- Assist with the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of online resources, learning materials and information, working closely with colleagues to ensure content remains accurate, accessible and up to date.
- Support budget administration, including processing relevant expenses and monitoring expenditure as required.
- Assist with event administration and the delivery of activities, training and other departmental events.
- Support colleagues with projects and initiatives across the Coaching and Equine team as required.

Stakeholder Support
- Provision of advice and guidance to volunteers, coaches and member groups in relation to activities and associated processes.
- Build and maintain positive working relationships with activity volunteers, coaches, advisory groups and relevant external stakeholders.
- Gather feedback from activity volunteers, coaches, member groups and the wider RDA network, identifying recurring themes, opportunities and concerns, escalating issues where appropriate, and providing insight to support the Head of Coaching and Equine and wider team.
- Support effective communication of activity and coaching information across the RDA network.

General
- Undertake such other duties as the line manager shall from time to time determine.
- Demonstrate the values and cultural aspirations of RDA in all work.
- Ensure due consideration is always given to our charitable aims and objectives and that this is demonstrated in all activities.
- Attend and support the National Championships and other key events as required, including planning and preparation activities in advance of events and operational support during delivery.

Person Specification

Essential
- Experience of coordinating activities, events, training, projects or programmes, with the ability to prioritise competing demands.
- Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with accuracy and attention to detail.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience of providing advice, guidance or customer support in a professional environment
- Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, volunteers and stakeholders.
- Understanding of, and ability to work effectively within, a volunteer-led environment.
- Empathy with the aims and values of RDA.
- Ability to use initiative, work independently and contribute effectively as part of a team.
- Working understanding of inclusion, equality, safeguarding and relevant good practice.
- Good digital literacy, including experience of Microsoft Office and other digital systems.

Desirable
- Knowledge or experience of equestrian sport, coaching or equine-related environments.
- Knowledge or experience of RDA and its activities.
- Understanding of carriage driving and its operational requirements.
- Experience of working within a charity or membership organisation.
- Experience of compliance, quality assurance or operational processes

title: Admin Assistant
description: Join Our OpCourage Veterans Mental Health Team! Exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic Administrator to join our Veterans Mental Health Team, supporting veterans and their families across the West Midlands. As one of the first points of contact for many of the veterans accessing our service, you will play a really important role in making sure they receive a warm, professional and supportive experience from the very first contact. Working alongside our dedicated team of clinicians, your role will include a range of general administrative duties, including answering calls and emails, managing appointments, maintaining accurate records, supporting clinical teams, data entry and helping the service run smoothly day to day. But this role is about much more than administration -- you'll be part of a team that genuinely cares about the work we do and the veterans we support. We are a passionate, hard-working and supportive team who take our work seriously... but we also believe in having great fun along the way! If you're organised, approachable, compassionate and enjoy working as part of a team, we'd love to hear from you. Come and join us and be part of something that makes a real difference to the lives of veterans and their families. To provide efficient secretarial and administrative support to the clinical team, adhering to procedures and processes within service timescales, whilst operating within a busy and demanding environment. Work effectively as a team member. Provide an administrative service across both pathways of the service, (urgent and non-urgent) including: word-processing, drafting and producing for example meeting notes, reports, letters and business documents from either audio or copy sources. Undertake general office duties as required including filing, photocopying, collating and distributing information, receipt and distribution of incoming and outgoing mail. Operate and maintain a robust, accurate and secure filing system that is easily accessible by all staff. Maintain spread sheets and databases including the production of regular information reports Linking in with NHS colleagues within our partnership including BSMHFT and LPFT and our Military Charity partners including Walking with the Wounded and The Ripple Pond. Be responsible for organising and servicing meetings / events as required, including room bookings, taking accurate notes, transcription and circulation as appropriate Procurement - order stationery, clinical supplies and equipment stock Use own initiative to meet tight deadlines Provide flexible administrative and clerical cover as required. This will involve working occasionally in both pathways, to provide cross cover arrangements.
